you_should_know.title: Group of over 150 Allina Health doctors in Twin Cities files notice for strike
you_should_know.summary: A group of over 150 doctors at Allina Health, a hospital and clinic system across the Twin Cities — Minneapolis and St. Paul, the capital city, just east of Minneapolis — has filed a 10-day unfair labor practice strike notice, their union said.
you_should_know.description: A group of over 150 Allina Health doctors in the Twin Cities has filed a 10-day unfair labor practice strike notice, their union said on Friday.
